title: Adventurous Umami Irish Dish Bake
description: A keto-friendly, adventurous Irish dish featuring cooking wine and a bake. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack positioned in the middle of the oven.
Mix the pork belly, shaggy thyme, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and drizzle with the cooking wine.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Slice into portions and serve hot.
Note: If using fresh thyme, be sure to chop it finely before adding it to the mixture.
Baste the pork belly with the pan juices during the last 20 minutes of cooking for added flavor and moisture.
